parts.text: I work at the airspace desk keeping the shared picture of the airspace, which includes the network of flight corridors between sites, the zones that group them, and the closures announced by the authorities. Since we work for all customer companies and have no business looking into any one company's operations, we want to know how much disruption a closure caused across customers when it is entered. I need the service to handle planned closures with a start and end time, as well as sudden ones that apply at once, keeping in mind that closures are often amended during the day, such as when an area is widened or an end time moves.
